description: A grouping layer above the user (groups, teams, organizations) with inherited roles/scopes.

requirements.description: A grouping layer must exist above individual users: groups (flat collections), teams (groups with an owner), and organizations (hierarchical container of teams). Role and scope assignments at a group/team/org level are inherited by members. User's effective roles in a realm are the union of directly assigned roles and all inherited roles. Group membership and role inheritance must be reflected in issued token claims.
requirements.deferred_reason: Groups, teams, and organization inheritance are multi-user product surfaces beyond the one-owner, many-principals model delivered here.
requirements.revisit_trigger: Multiple households or organizations require inherited membership and permissions.
requirements.title: Groups, Teams, and Organization Hierarchy with Inherited Roles
